native_rule.creator: bhanu.nandanampati@nopalcyber.com
native_rule.name: [NopalCyber] Hive Ransomware
native_rule.s1ql:
"endpoint.os.process.name = 'Windows'
AND
(
  (
    event.category = 'Process'
    AND
    (
      (
        cmdline contains:anycase 'Windows_x64_encrypt.dll'
        OR cmdline contains:anycase 'Windows_x64_encrypt.exe'
        OR cmdline contains:anycase 'Windows_x32_encrypt.dll'
        OR cmdline contains:anycase 'Windows_x32_encrypt.exe'
      )
      OR tgt.process.cmdline RegExp '\.exe\s{1,10}-u\s{1,10}[A-Za-z0-9]{6,32}\:[A-Za-z0-9]{6,32}$'
    )
    AND src.process.commandLine Does Not Contain '\EnCase.exe'
  )
  OR
  (
    event.category = 'File'
    AND
    (
      tgt.file.path contains:anycase '\Windows_x64_encrypt.dll'
      OR tgt.file.path contains:anycase '\Windows_x64_encrypt.exe'
      OR tgt.file.path contains:anycase '\Windows_x32_encrypt.dll'
      OR tgt.file.path contains:anycase '\Windows_x32_encrypt.exe'
    )
    AND
    (
      tgt.file.path EndsWith Anycase '.exe'
      OR tgt.file.path EndsWith Anycase '.dll'
    )
    AND src.process.commandLine Does Not Contain '\EnCase.exe'
  )
)"
